reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering ocean minerals, fish, cooking ingredients and dishes, geodes, fruit trees, and archaeological artifacts were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established fish and place names, gameplay effects, tree growth conditions, mineral terminology, object gender, artifact context, and quoted tile terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

OceanStone_Description.source: An old legend claims these stones are the mosaics of ancient mermaids.
OceanStone_Description.translation: O legendă veche susține că aceste pietre sunt mozaicurile unor sirene străvechi.

Oil_Description.translation: Un ulei de gătit bun la orice.

OilofGarlic_Description.source: Drink this and weaker monsters will avoid you.
OilofGarlic_Description.translation: Bea-l, iar monștrii mai slabi te vor evita.

OmniGeode_Description.source: A blacksmith can break this open for you. These geodes contain a wide variety of minerals.
OmniGeode_Description.translation: Un fierar ți-o poate sparge. Aceste geode conțin o mare varietate de minerale.

OmniGeodeStone_Description.source: Break apart to obtain omni geodes.
OmniGeodeStone_Description.translation: Sparge-o pentru a obține geode omni.

Opal_Name.preservationReason: Opal is the standard Romanian mineral name with the same spelling as the English source.

Opal_Description.source: Its internal structure causes it to reflect a rainbow of light.
Opal_Description.translation: Structura sa internă îl face să reflecte lumina în culorile curcubeului.

Orange_Description.source: Juicy, tangy, and bursting with sweet summer aroma.
Orange_Description.translation: Zemoasă, acrișoară și plină de aroma dulce a verii.

OrangeSapling_Description.source: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Orange tree. Bears fruit in the summer. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
OrangeSapling_Description.translation: Are nevoie de 28 de zile pentru a deveni un portocal matur. Rodește vara. Crește doar dacă cele 8 „dale” din jur sunt libere.

OrnamentalFan_Description.source: This exquisite fan most likely belonged to a noblewoman. Historians believe that the valley was a popular sixth-era vacation spot for the wealthy.
OrnamentalFan_Description.translation: Acest evantai rafinat a aparținut, cel mai probabil, unei nobile. Istoricii cred că valea era o destinație de vacanță populară pentru cei bogați în cea de-a șasea eră.

OrnateNecklace_Description.source: A fancy necklace found in the water outside of the bath house. It's still wet...
OrnateNecklace_Description.translation: Un colier elegant găsit în apa din fața Băii publice. Încă este ud...
